page.content:
Lyme Regis fossilist whose marine reptiles trained Victorian paleontology.

How Mary Anning connects

  • Location: Lyme Regis — Mary Anning worked the fossil ledges at Lyme Regis.
  • Topic: Dinosaurs — Anning's Jurassic Coast trade trained the paleontology that later framed dinosaurs.

What is Mary Anning?

Mary Anning collected ichthyosaurs, plesiosaurs, and a pterosaur on the Jurassic Coast. She was not a dinosaur specialist, but her trade made the science that later named Dinosauria.

Key threads lead to Lyme Regis and Dinosaurs.
